assessment: The PPMI time-to-initiation cohort models demographic, clinical, CSF and imaging predictors of starting symptomatic Parkinson treatment. Ground sage and dream enactment frequency are outside the contrast.
The NET-PD LS1 secondary analysis contrasts metabolic syndrome strata for change in total and motor UPDRS and symbol-digit performance, without sage or enactment-frequency measures.

Two PET tracers compare dopamine transporter binding and brain network activity across isolated RBD, Parkinson disease and controls. Sage intake and changes in dream enactment frequency are outside the design.
The RBDQ threshold is contrasted across blepharoclonus groups in Parkinson disease. Sage exposure and post-intake dream enactment frequency are outside the design.
The study uses the first-visit Geriatric Depression Scale and other routine questionnaires to classify Parkinson depression, without an intake or dream-frequency analysis.
The four cases describe clinically observed unresponsiveness consistent with episodic coma in Lewy body disorders, without ground sage exposure or dream enactment counts.

This case tracks motor progression and putaminal imaging and pathology in multiple system atrophy. Its clinical exposure history concerns antiparkinsonian medicines, without a sage or dream-frequency contrast.

Stool sequencing compares Parkinson disease, isolated RBD and healthy participants. The RBD questionnaire describes the iRBD group, with no measured sage intake or sage-based event frequency comparison.

Video polysomnography relates respiratory events, periodic limb movements and REM sleep without atonia to motor status. REM sleep without atonia is a physiological measure and no sage exposure was assigned or measured.

The machine-learning study combines recorded clinical scales and blood tests to classify mild cognitive impairment in Parkinson disease. The variables do not represent sage or dream enactment frequency.

This blinded cross-sectional study compares cerebrospinal fluid alpha-synuclein seeding results across neurological diagnoses. Suspected RBD in supplementary stratification supplies no sage exposure or enactment-frequency estimate.

Apple Macintosh is the equipment used to quantify MRI volumes in Parkinson participants and nonhuman primates. The study measures brain structure without exposure to apple or a dystonia severity comparison.
A C Apple is an author. The study uses MRI and diffusion metrics to distinguish Parkinson disease, PSP and corticobasal syndrome, with no baked apple or dystonia severity contrast.
The cohorts have inherited sensorineural hearing loss and undergo mitochondrial sequencing. The comparison is genetic and audiological, without apple exposure or a Parkinson dystonia outcome.

A case with nuchal dystonia predating terminal debility choked while being fed apple in an autopsy-confirmed PSP series. Apple is implicated in choking, with no preparation or dystonia-severity contrast.
An Apple iPad displays motor cues in cortical ECoG testing in Parkinson disease and essential tremor. The paper discusses separate earlier dystonia work and contains no fruit exposure.

Table 1 reports apple chewing time as an orofacial function test in two drug-induced oromandibular dystonia cases. Dystonia ratings describe the cases, and the treatment was botulinum toxin. No baked-apple treatment or severity contrast follows chewing.

The possible PSP case with dystonic arm posturing describes habitual raw pawpaw from the Annonaceae family. The single exposure history concerns a different plant and does not estimate a Malus apple effect on dystonia.
Adam's apple is the site of a sensory maneuver for hypophonia in a patient with pathogenic FIG4 variants and truncal dystonia. There is no fruit exposure.
Apple Watch and HealthKit are monitoring technologies in a digital Parkinson feasibility study. The study does not compare edible apple preparations or treatment effects on dystonia.
Acoustic measures of voice in adductor laryngeal dystonia compare botulinum toxin before and after treatment. The recorded sentences are assessment tasks, without a baked-apple treatment contrast.

This cohort protocol plans Parkinson prevalence/incidence and RBD screening, with coffee and tea intake among covariates. It does not specify ground cinnamon exposure or a daytime sleepiness-severity result.

The article discusses rat nigrostriatal protection after injected isolated naringin and cites Leem PMID24797334 for the core neurotoxin result. The Parkinson rest-tremor discussion is background, with no raw grapefruit intake or tremor outcome.

The research perspective refers to the same Leem rat study PMID24797334 and reports mechanistic signals after intraperitoneal naringin. It offers no raw grapefruit treatment or rest-tremor measurement.

Grapefruit is a possible rutin source in the abstract. The review reports isolated rutin in a rat model for rotation, locomotion and motor coordination, without a grapefruit or rest-tremor comparison.
The Parkinson sleep review evaluates clonazepam, melatonin and other pharmacological options for RBD. It gives no sage arm or sage-linked dream enactment frequency result.

The Caribbean comparison surveys soursop, sugar apple and custard apple fruits and associated infusions. The parkinsonism phenotype includes RBD, but the measured plant exposure is Annonaceae rather than ground sage.

Mothers received ground dry cardamom pods and seeds mixed into rodent diet, with offspring development, behavior and biochemical endpoints. It did not assay constipation or Parkinson disease. PD in the source denotes postnatal day.
The review describes anxiety-like tests among possible behavioral phenotyping tools in Parkinson mouse models. There is no paprika administration or paprika-based anxiety comparison.
Paprika and Capsicum are named as food sources of serotonin. The review discusses neurotransmitter mechanisms and mood, without an intake study measuring anxiety after smoked paprika.
Apple is the wearable brand in this remote Parkinson monitoring platform. Its interventions and measures concern DBS and monitoring rather than baked fruit or dystonia change.
Apple Vision and Google MediaPipe are computer vision frameworks validated against tremor measurements. No apple food or dystonia severity comparison is involved.

The CLSA baseline contrasts a one-question possible RBD screen by demographic, lifestyle and psychiatric variables, excluding reported Parkinson disease. The alcohol and smoking variables do not provide a ground sage exposure or episode-frequency estimate.
Applesauce is suggested as a purée for medication administration in the swallowing section of the CurePSP consensus. Dystonia management is addressed separately and no apple effect was evaluated.

Cinnamon was an odor-identification stimulus in both smell test kits. Daytime sleepiness was a covariate in the anosmia model for community older adults, with no ground cinnamon intake or post-exposure sleepiness comparison.

The indexed abstract describes pathway manipulation in rats and loss of REM atonia after inactivating medullary inhibitory neurons. It reports no ground sage comparison or human dream enactment frequency.
The indexed abstract reports a systematic review of tests supporting multiple system atrophy diagnosis. RBD is a diagnostic feature rather than a sage-related outcome.

The indexed abstract compares core clinical features including RBD in prodromal dementia with Lewy bodies and matched controls. The comparison is diagnostic and contains no sage intervention or dream-frequency estimate.
The indexed abstract studies whether clinician-rated probable RBD and hyposmia predict postmortem Lewy-type synucleinopathy. There is no sage exposure or dream enactment frequency comparison.

The indexed abstract contrasts quality of life in isolated RBD, Parkinson disease and healthy controls and models fatigue and depression. It does not compare sage or count enactment events after intake.
The indexed abstract follows older people with tremor for incident Parkinson disease and uses probable RBD as a predictor. There is no ground sage exposure or enactment-frequency result.

The indexed abstract describes sleep disorder screening and objective sleep measures in memory-clinic patients. Probable RBD prevalence is described without sage exposure or a change in episode frequency.
The indexed abstract uses RBD and other nonmotor features to classify risk when validating a subtle motor questionnaire. It does not study sage intake or consequences for dream enactment.
The indexed abstract compares iRBD diagnosis, injuries and course by sex within FARPRESTO. Injury prevalence at diagnosis is distinct from dream episode frequency after a sage exposure.
The indexed abstract relates plasma neurofilament levels to orthostatic hypotension and later phenoconversion in isolated RBD. There is no reported sage exposure or dream frequency comparison.
The indexed abstract validates computerized video-rated eyelid closure against clinical blepharospasm severity scales. It makes no apple or dietary comparison.

The indexed abstract compares dopaminergic on/off states for perceptual decisions and includes dopa-unresponsive focal dystonia as a comparison group. There is no report of fruit treatment or dystonia severity by diet.

The indexed abstract describes pallidal DBS and electrophysiology in Parkinson disease and isolated dystonia. Stimulation is the exposure and beta oscillations are evaluated without an apple contrast.
The indexed abstract reports a 7-tesla MRI method for segmenting globus pallidus for surgical planning. Dystonia motivates the clinical application rather than an apple-based outcome.
The indexed abstract describes SPG7 genotype and clinical phenotypes in 16 patients. Dystonia is one phenotype and no apple exposure is reported.
The indexed abstract reports intracranial recordings during a figure-eight task in children with dystonia. There is no apple exposure or dietary contrast.
The indexed abstract studies clinical and video-derived features of gait dystonia severity in cerebral palsy, without a baked apple or dietary exposure.

The indexed abstract describes natural history and clinical predictors of survival in autopsy-confirmed progressive supranuclear palsy. Segmental dystonia is a clinical feature without a reported apple exposure contrast.
